title: plugin-security: the delegated-admin gate refuses an organization administrator who names one of two holders of a permission set
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：#32164 P2（PR #32306）契约审查 6813617327 ④ should-fix 4。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150)。Blocked-by #32306. Blocks #31698 PR-2.

## What

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` (the grant leg of the organization-boundary check, near the `[ADR-0150 D8 R1]` comment) still reasons from the insert re-stamp that PR #32306 removes: "the write seam re-stamps the column from the name with no caller, so that holder is judged as well". After #32306 a named package is refused when it does not hold the name and is never re-stamped. The gate judges the named holder and then the bare name. A bare name two packages hold is `refused`, so the second leg refuses an organization administrator who names one of the two holders.

Fail-closed today. Reachable only after #31698 PR-2 (second holder), where it removes the capability #32164 exists for: a delegated administrator granting one of two same-named sets.

## Acceptance

- When the grant names a package, the gate judges that holder only; the bare-name leg runs only when no package is named.
- The comment matches the seam after #32306.
- Pins: a two-holder stand-in registry; an organization administrator naming holder A inside the boundary is admitted; naming a holder outside it is refused; naming no package keeps today's refusal. CONTROL: one holder unchanged.
- `Clause-②:` measured (likely a widening of an over-refusal; declare FROM → TO).

## 业务理由

谁受益：组织管理员（委托管理）。场景：两个包都带同名权限集，管理员指定其中一个包授予本组织用户。不做：#31698 PR-2 后这类授予一律被拒，只能由平台管理员代办。

## 读者

`domain:server` 席位（专题 #31527 派），#32306 合并后、#31698 PR-2 前；起点 `delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 grant 分支与 `grantPackageOf`。

## 查重

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue delegated-admin-gate two holders permission set package` → 20 hits, open ones are seat posts only (#6015, #6026); none tracks this leg. No duplicate.
